key_insight: Q-PhotoMarket shows that photonic hybrid quantum neural networks can achieve competitive financial market prediction only when the photonic design space is systematically explored rather than relying on a single architecture.
engineering_relevance: The framework provides a practical design-space exploration workflow for selecting robust photonic HQNN configurations, making quantum-enhanced finance models more reproducible and tunable for hardware-aware deployment.
method: Explored 5,000+ valid photonic configurations across input states, circuit architectures, entangling models, and measurement strategies.
Used Bayesian optimization to accelerate search over the photonic design space.
Added threshold calibration and prediction-collapse diagnostics to evaluate imbalanced return settings more reliably.
evidence_signal: The study evaluated more than 5,000 photonic HQNN configurations across U.S., Indian, and cryptocurrency markets and reported consistent architectural patterns with competitive performance versus classical baselines.
watch_item: Results depend on threshold choice and valid-configuration constraints, so performance may shift under different market regimes or photonic hardware capabilities.
paper_title: Q-PhotoMarket: A Design Space Exploration Framework for Photonic Hybrid Quantum Neural Networks in Financial Market Prediction
